blocks.text: Malacañang continues to keep a hands-off policy in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, a Palace official said on Thursday, after reporters sought for reaction on the opinions of former Supreme Court magistrates on how impeachment laws in the Philippines should be interpreted.
